description: Pinned, version-locked specification of AutoShield's initial MITRE reference corpus. It defines a BOUNDED, hand-curated subset of CWE and CAPEC (web-application and containerized-service topics), NOT the entire catalogues. A version change requires an explicit edit of this file and fresh verification of every selected record.
corpus_build_utc_note: Written to provenance.ingested_at_utc of every document instead of the wall clock, so that repeating the build produces identical documents and no store writes (the store treats a provenance-only difference as a change). It is the time this pinned build was specified.
